About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

Position Overview:

We are building a multi-region, 10,000+ GPU AI cloud infrastructure platform for external customers. As the platform scales rapidly across multiple data centers and geographies, we need a seasoned Cloud Project Manager to drive the end-to-end delivery of complex infrastructure and cloud platform software projects — from new data center builds and GPU cluster deployments to cloud platform software product development, feature launches, and cross-regional expansions. You will be the central coordination point across infrastructure engineering, software engineering, operations, vendors, and leadership, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the quality standards required for a mission-critical AI compute platform.

What you will be responsible for:

    • Own end-to-end project delivery for AI cloud infrastructure and cloud platform software initiatives: new data center builds, GPU cluster deployments (1K–100K GPU scale), network rollouts, cloud platform software product development, feature launches, and multi-region expansions.
    • Drive cloud platform software product project management: coordinate the delivery of control plane, tenant management, billing/quota, API/portal, scheduling, observability, and other platform software modules from requirements through release.
    • Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, resource plans, and risk registers; drive execution to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery.
    • Coordinate cross-functional teams — compute, network, storage, control plane, software engineering, DC operations, and vendor partners — to align on deliverables, dependencies, and integration points.
    • Manage vendor and contractor relationships (colocation providers, hardware suppliers, ISPs, system integrators); negotiate timelines, track deliverables, and resolve escalations.
    • Establish and run governance cadences: steering committees, sprint/release planning, weekly syncs, milestone reviews, and executive reporting.
    • Align infrastructure delivery and software development timelines to ensure integrated, end-to-end platform readiness for each region launch.
    • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and blockers proactively; drive issue resolution across organizational boundaries.
    • Define and enforce project management standards, templates, and processes (change management, RAID logs, status reporting, Agile ceremonies) to enable repeatable, scalable delivery.
    • Track and report project KPIs: delivery velocity, schedule adherence, budget variance, sprint velocity, and resource utilization.
    • Support capacity planning and demand forecasting by providing delivery timeline inputs to leadership.
    • Drive post-project reviews and lessons-learned processes to continuously improve delivery efficiency.

    How you will stand out:

      • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification preferred.
      • 7+ years of project management experience in cloud infrastructure, data center, or cloud platform software product delivery.
      • Proven track record delivering complex, multi-workstream projects — both infrastructure (data center builds, large-scale compute/network deployments) and cloud platform software products (control plane, billing, API/portal, scheduling) — on time and within budget.
      • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure components: compute (GPU/CPU servers), networking (Spine-Leaf, InfiniBand, SDN), storage, and data center facilities (power, cooling).
      • Solid understanding of cloud platform software architecture: multi-tenant control planes, Kubernetes, microservices, API design, CI/CD, and software release management.
      • Experience managing cross-regional or global infrastructure and software projects with distributed teams and multiple vendor partners.
      • Excellent stakeholder management skills; ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams, senior leadership, and external partners.
      • Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid); experience with tools such as Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or equivalent.
      • Strong risk management, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
      • Experience in AI/HPC infrastructure, GPU cloud, or hyperscale data center projects is strongly preferred.
      • Fluent in both English and Mandarin Chinese (written and spoken) — required for cross-regional coordination across global teams.

      What you will experience working with us:

      • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
      • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
      • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
      • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
      • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
      • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
      • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

As Kalshi scales, we are looking for an experienced tax professional to build and own the tax function across the company.

You will own federal and state income tax compliance, state tax examinations, ASC 740 provision support, excise and transaction-tax positions, information reporting, international tax planning, and relationships with external tax advisors.

  • Own federal, state, indirect, and international tax matters across Kalshi's entities

  • Oversee federal consolidated and multistate income tax compliance and manage relationships with external tax preparers

  • Take end-to-end ownership of state tax examinations and controversy matters, including response strategy, document production, deadlines, and coordination with outside advisors

  • Own ASC 740 tax provision support and tax-related financial statement disclosures in partnership with Technical Accounting

  • Build and maintain a comprehensive tax calendar covering federal, state, international, and information-reporting obligations

  • Drive tax planning for new products, new markets, international expansion, and entity-structuring decisions

  • Evaluate VAT, GST, withholding, transfer pricing, nexus, and apportionment considerations as the business expands

  • Own information reporting, including 1099 processes and customer tax documentation

  • Direct and challenge external tax advisors, including PwC and EY, while managing scopes, budgets, and auditor-independence requirements

  • Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and business teams on novel tax questions in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment

  • Determine how the tax function should evolve over time, including what capabilities should remain outsourced and where Kalshi should build internally

What You Bring

  • 10–15 years of progressive tax experience in public accounting, industry, or a combination of both

  • Active US CPA

  • Deep corporate income tax expertise with hands-on ASC 740 experience in a PCAOB-audited environment

  • Strong multistate and SALT experience, including meaningful exposure to tax audits, examinations, or controversy

  • The ability to independently develop and defend tax positions where precedent may be limited or evolving

  • Comfort operating in a highly regulated environment and partnering with Legal when tax issues intersect with regulatory or litigation matters

  • Exposure to excise taxes, transaction-based taxes, and information reporting is strongly preferred

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. The Central Data Team (CDT) is only a few months old, but data has been Keyrock's lifeblood since day one. We're now building the Keyrock Data Platform to give Keyrockers, and the AI agents working alongside them, the data and context they need to act fast and autonomously within agreed boundaries and aligned with our shared goals. Doing that means taking data from across the company and making sense of it in real time for all the functions that depend on it: trading desks, wealth and asset management, product, risk, finance, compliance, and research to name a few.

  • Build streaming and batch pipelines that ingest, normalise, and distribute market, trading, and portfolio data, resilient to feed and exchange failures.

Our Recruitment Process

We’re after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? Someone who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes. We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Compliance Analyst to join our Compliance team with a primary focus on KYC and KYB onboarding operations. This is a do-er role - you will be in the queue every day reviewing applications, making risk decisions, and working directly with partners and customers to move onboarding forward without sacrificing compliance quality. You will be expected to own your work end to end, exercise sound judgment on complex cases, and contribute to building and improving the processes that support our onboarding program.

This role sits at the intersection of compliance and operations. You are not here to advise - you are here to execute, and to do it well.

 

What You Will Do

  • Review and disposition transaction monitoring alerts and KYC/KYB onboarding applications end to end - including customer profile review, document verification, beneficial ownership analysis, sanctions and PEP screening, adverse media assessment, and transactional activity analysis

  • Conduct enhanced due diligence on High Risk applicants - including source of funds and source of wealth assessment, business model review, and full beneficial ownership chain documentation

  • Make well-reasoned SAR recommendations - clearly articulating why activity is or is not suspicious and documenting your analysis in a manner that is complete and defensible to a regulator

  • Draft SAR narratives that meet FinCEN quality standards

  • Send RFIs to customers or partners where additional information is needed to resolve an alert or application and follow through to receipt and documentation of the response

  • Support periodic KYC refresh reviews on existing customers as part of the Company's ongoing due diligence program

  • Contribute to onboarding and investigation policy development - if you see a gap, flag it and propose a solution

  • Stay current on FinCEN advisories, FATF typologies, and emerging financial crime trends relevant to Rain's product set - including stablecoin, virtual asset, and agentic payment typologies

  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools and on-chain transaction analysis

What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.
